text:
jules_sales: MerchantOne is ready to sign. They want sustained 5k RPS for promo windows, short 2x bursts, and 200ms p95. Asking for reserved GPU slab + burst-credit pricing and SLA text. Can eng confirm sizing and autoscale fallback?

marco_sre: Quick Q — avg token length and % of reranks?

jules_sales: Avg ~330 tokens, rerank ~6%. Mostly single-turn gen.

anya_prod: With seq ~330 and limiting queueing to keep p95<200ms, expect ~850 RPS per A100-eq GPU in steady state. Recommend 6 reserved GPUs. KV cache warmups can boost ~20%.

kevin_infra: For short 2x bursts (10m) add a 4-GPU burst pool. Spot-backed is cost-effective but document eviction fallback to 8-bit quantized variant.

sami_se: Two customer options to present: (1) reserved 6 GPUs + spot burst credits (cheaper, documented fallback) (2) reserved 6 + reserved burst (premium, stronger SLA).

marco_sre: Autoscale proposal: monitor 30s RPS avg, scale up when >85% reserved for 60s, cooldown 120s. Use burst pool up to max. If burst provisioning fails within 120s, auto-fallback to quantized model; remaining overflow -> 429s. Notify via webhook and dashboard.

kevin_infra: Runbook note: preheat KV 10m before campaigns using preheat API. Example: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.example/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{\"job\":\"kv_warm\",\"model\":\"merchant-chat-v1\",\"start_in\":\"10m\",\"duration_mins\":15}'`

jules_sales: Security asks: CMEK/KMS, VPC peering, 12mo audit logs, SOC2 addendum. Any blockers?

sami_se: No technical blockers. CMEK & VPC supported for Private; audit logs exportable. SOC2 addendum needs legal ~5 business days. We'll prepare checklist.

anya_prod: Observability: will create tenant dashboard (p50/p95/p99, token-cost CSV, KV hit rate). Alert: p95>200ms for two consecutive 5-min windows -> page oncall.

jules_sales: Action items: @anya_prod perf table + final GPU count; @kevin_infra preheat/runbook snippet; @sami_se security checklist & SOC2 ETA; @marco_sre SLA blurb. I'll package for legal/finance.

deploy_bot: Reminder: dedicated provision needs RFC + AZ affinity. Link: https://rfd.redwood.example/requests/10111
